nonblocking_observations.detail: Historical chain record 324 (source cd0c1b09) binds .devai/state/sensor-readings/test_coverage_depth/SR-01d9bca900c51904.json with sha fc4b0dcb. That path was absent on main. The old-74 run (record 360) created it with sha 264d6e66. At HEAD the old binding therefore does not match, which is one of the 13 historical limitations. This is disclosed in evaluation-74b9eec8/ec2-historical-custody-interpretation.md and X21427-custody-and-provenance-audit.json. The original old bytes are kept in the R-0036 replay canonical-readings archive. No pre-existing canonical file was overwritten. No action needed beyond keeping this disclosure.

verifyGovernedUpgradeCompatibility runs only when a governed path differs from its 1073-reference hash. It then requires the exact ADOPTION bytes for both sealed paths and for all six generated files, the receipt, the authority sources, the DEVAI lock identity and empty C6 bindings. Any later DEVAI upgrade will therefore be refused by design and will need a new reviewed manifest version. This is the intended finite scope under ADR-0062 and is recorded here for future upgraders.

limitations: Read-only Git review. No tests, producers, native verbs, CI or GitHub API calls were run. The 58 local/CI test PASS results, CI 40052489971, the five required checks, the verified-local-rc remote fallback, signed RC 80505ac/run 40034673414, and the live state of #211 and PR224 were not re-observed.

Chain record-hash linkage was not recomputed with the DEVAI algorithm. This review relies on prefix identity, sequence contiguity, artifact hashes, and the recorded doctor_exit 0 and chain_verification_exit 0.
External artifact sources under /Volumes/Development/.codex/artifacts were not compared. Only the committed copies and their manifests were verified.

Test-population figures (13641, 1518, 2260 and 592 files at 56.53%) and inventory-performance statistics (59 pool files, 38 durations, 31 baseline, p95 2917, mean 469) were taken from the committed reports and readings. They were not re-executed.
